x-k-k1-01.title: Which sign show di way to parking lot?
x-k-k1-01.goal: Read three short road signs, join di words with arrow and symbol described, then judge which one really lead visitor to park; defend your answer when friend read only half.
x-k-k1-01.material:
Visitor drive up to school and wan park car for one hour. Three signs dey there (no pictures; dem describe am with words).

Sign A: white letters ‘주차 금지’ on red board. Red circle with diagonal line cross small car picture. Dem fix am to school fence.
Sign B: blue board, white letters ‘방문자 주차장’ and arrow point right. E stand beside road.
Sign C: green board, white letters ‘주차장 출구’ and arrow point back toward road. E hang above narrow lane where cars dey drive out.

Words: 주차(장) = parking (lot); 방문자 = visitor; 입구 = entrance; 출구 = exit.

x-k-k1-01.thinking.1: No stop at one familiar word (주차장)
x-k-k1-01.thinking.2: Answer friend with proof from sign
x-k-k1-01.prereq.1: Know say arrow for sign show direction to go
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.prompt: Which sign visitor suppose follow to park?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.0: List wetin each sign talk with words, and wetin symbol or arrow add.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.1: For each sign, ask: e dey send car inside, outside, or nowhere?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.a: 주차장 dey for this sign, but na only one of two words. Check wetin second word and arrow talk about direction cars dey go.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.b: This sign get 주차 too. Look at red circle with slash: wetin this kind symbol usually mean?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.c: You join visitor word, parking word and arrow together. Na so you read whole sign.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.o.d: Sign B or Sign C; both get 주차장 and arrow
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.d: True, both get 주차장 and arrow, but check other word on Sign C and direction its arrow point.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.explain: Sign B na for visitors, e name parking lot and show direction. Sign A get same first word but symbol say no parking. Sign C name parking lot too, but 출구 mean exit, so e show where cars dey leave.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.prompt: Friend talk: ‘Sign C get 주차장, so make we drive inside there.’ Answer am in one or two English sentences, using wetin di sign really talk.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Which word for Sign C different from Sign B own?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Where cars dey go for lane wey get exit sign?

x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: My friend go know where to look next?
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.0: Sign C say 출구, wey mean exit. Cars dey drive out there, so make we look for entrance, like direction arrow for Sign B.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.modelNote.0: E name di key word and di entrance wey dey miss.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.model.1: 주차장 na only half of am. Di other word, 출구, tell us say cars dey leave there, so we go dey drive wrong way.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: E explain di risk based on direction.

x-k-k1-07.title: Wetin time you fit enter library?

x-k-k1-07.s.s1.r.b: You see say this line give hours for normal day.

x-k-k1-07.s.s2.because.model.1: No come for lunch time, 12 to 1. Library get break then, so choose another time between 9 and 6.

x-k-k1-02.title: If rain fall, dem go hold di picnic?

x-k-k1-02.goal: Compare note written in English with original Korean notice, find line wey claim more than di notice, then write di rule yourself in Korean.
x-k-k1-02.material:
Teacher put notice for classroom door:

내일은 소풍 가요.
9시까지 학교에 오세요.

비가 오면 소풍을 안 가요.

Words: 소풍 = outing/picnic; 도시락 = lunch box; 비 = rain; 오다 = to come (비가 오다 = it rains); 안 = not.

Joon read am and write four notes in English (shown below).

More words (for step 2): 눈 = snow (눈이 오다 = it snows); 공원 = park.

x-k-k1-04.s.s1.st.2.after: 동생이 na subject of 아파요, so younger sibling sick. 유나 absent because she go together (같이 가요). Drop first guess.
